title: Implement store-and-forward pipeline: receive -> IPFS -> log -> gossipsub
description:
Implement the pipeline that runs after a valid article is received: (1) write to IPFS and obtain CID, (2) insert into Message-ID->CID map, (3) append to each group log named in Newsgroups:, (4) publish tip advertisement over gossipsub, (5) record metrics. The pipeline is async and the IHAVE handler waits for IPFS write before responding 235. Artifact: transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs.

Acceptance:
- 235 response only after IPFS write and log append succeed
- If IPFS write fails, article is not added to log; 400-series error returned
- Newsgroups: field with multiple groups appends to each log
- Pipeline metrics: articles_ingested_total, ipfs_write_latency_seconds
- Integration test: inject article, verify CID in IPFS and entry in group log
